definitions.full: H1641. garar [ גָּרַר ] verb drag, drag away (Late Hebrew id. , Arabic Aramaic גְּרַר , ; Assyrian garâru , run , Zim BP 102 ; etc.) — Qal Imperfect suffix יְנֹרֵהוּ Hab 1:15 , יְגוֺרֵם Prov 21:7 — drag away , fishes in net, figurative Hab 1:15 (Chaldeans, their opponents); violence, the wicked Prov 21:7 . Niph`al (read Qal ? Samaritan יָגוֺר compare Di) Imperfect יִגָּ֑ר Lev 11:7 with accusative of congnate meaning with verb לֹאיִֿגָּ֑ר גֵּרָה = (the) cud he cheweth not , compare also Deut 14:8 ᵐ5 ⅏ (Di). Po`al Participle (denominative; so Late Hebrew Qal & Niph`al) בַּמְּגֵרָה מִגֹרָרוֺת 1Kin 7:9 sawn with the saw . Hithpo`el מִתְגּוֺרֵ֑ר סַעַר Jer 36:23 a (sweeping) roaring whirlwind (|| 23:19 has מִתְחוֺלֵל ). On יִתְגּוֺרָרוּ Hosea 7:14 , see I. גדד גור, .
